description: On the table in front of you are a clear plastic container, a small blue-lidded jar, a pink frosted donut squishy, a slice-of-bread squishy, a Rubik’s cube, and a couple of small toy figures. The left hand stays resting on the left side while the right hand reaches to the right, pinches and lifts a small yellow toy figure, then moves it leftward over the clear container and releases it inside, leaving the right hand hovering above afterward.
